title_suffix: finer certified endpoints (1e-400) and deeper outer witness on PR1424 (148 bootstrap steps, eta=beta=1e-405, kappa grid 1e-395); construction unchanged
summary: Repairs the fine Mercator engine of #1479/#1510/#1513 (odd term count made its lower log end an upper bound; finding PR1519 philippeVV), adds an independent exact atanh oracle stage, recomputes every endpoint certificate with the repaired engine, and keeps PR1424's construction unchanged. The certified complex endpoints (native and conservative) are refined from the inherited 1e-24 bracket to 1e-400: the retained engines still certify the 1e-24 bracket, and finer-constant copies of both rational engines certify accept at the endpoint and reject at endpoint+1e-400. The outer witness settings are deepened (bootstrap steps 148, eta = beta = 1e-405, backoff 1e-408, final kappa grid 1e-395) and the decimal fields are exact. kappa moves from 0.001676855229071321886206381217337893 to 0..
credits: Finding of the fine-Mercator lower-bound bug: PR1519 (philippeVV). Lineage of the outer-witness/endpoint refinements: PR1534 and PR1549 (midhatn), PR1485 (rohanarun), PR1479/PR1510/PR1513/PR1536 (jeremykothe2). PR1424, PR1319 and PR1297 (rohanarun: outer witness refinement, 74-replica exact fill, four cold kernels 531/543/555/567); PR1377 finer kappa grid and PR1274 helper-donor kernel (jeremykothe2); PR1286, PR1193 (jeremydiviney), PR1148 (Thomas DiFiore), PR1195/1196 and the retained lineage named in those packages. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
